questions.question: Newspapers told us about the events that happen all over the world.
questions.solution: Use 'tell' in place of 'told'. Explanation:- Yeh ek fact hai isliye 'present indefinite tense' ka use kiya jaayega.

questions.question: Usually, Ratheesh hasn't  take part in these types of events because of  his hectic schedule.
questions.solution: use 'doesn't' instead of 'hasn't'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan usually se pata chal rha hai ki yahan Ratheesh ka habitual action hai isliye ise present indefinite tense me likhenge.

questions.question: I am waiting for you for the last two hours but you did not bother to turn up in time.
options: I am waiting for you for
the last two hours but you
did not bother to turn up in time.
questions.solution: Use 'had been' in place of 'am'. Explanation:- yahan per 'did not bother' se pata chal raha hai ki yeh past ki baat aur 'wait' karne bala action isse bhi pahle hua tha, isliye usko present perfect continuous nahi balki past perfect continuous (had been waiting) mein likhna padega.

questions.question: He allowed his son to drive but he warn him of the danger.
questions.solution: use 'warned' instead of 'warn'. Explanation:- kyunki sentence ka meaning ye hai ki usne uske bete ko khatre ke liye warn kiya tha. Isliye past tense ka use hoga.

questions.question: Did you baked the chocolate cake yourself this time?
questions.solution: use 'bake' instead of 'baked'. Explanation:- kyunki do/does/did ke baad verb ki first form ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: As it has been raining heavily since two hours, the children are  at home.
options: As it has been raining heavily
questions.solution: use 'for' instead of 'since'. Explanation:- kyunki 'since' ka use 'point of time' ke liye kiya jaata hai aur 'for' ka use duration of time ke liye.

questions.question: Torrential rains and winds of up to 170 km per hour swept away roads, homes and bridges and knocking down power and communication lines.
questions.solution: use 'knocked' instead of 'knocking'. Explanation:- kyunki 'swept' verb hai aur sentence ke meaning se pta chal rha ki sentence past me likha gya isliye and conjunction se connected verb 'knocked' bhi past me likhi jaayegi.

questions.question: How long are you learning English for?
questions.solution: Use have you been learning in place of are you learning. Explanation:- kyunki 'for+duration' ke sath present perfect continuous ka use kiya jaata hai. Note:- bhale hi 'how long' sentence ke shuru me likha hai lekin structure for+time wala ban rha hai.

questions.question: Vidya put on her mask, sanitise her hands  and walked into the shop.
questions.solution: use 'sanitised' instead of 'sanitise'. Explanation:- kyunki poora sentence past me hai isliye teeno verbs 'put', 'sanitised' and 'walked' past tense me likhi gayi hai.

questions.question: I had walked for most of the day to Kanpur and then get on the train by Mumbai.
options: get on the train by Mumbai
questions.solution: use 'got' instead of 'get' and 'to' instead of 'by'. Explanation:- kyunki had walked se pata chal rha hai ki sentence past me chal rha hai isiliye get ko got krna hoga aur direction ke liye 'to' preposition ka use krte hai.

questions.question: This is indeed, the first time in my life that I hear such an interesting story.
options: time in my life that I hear
questions.solution: Use 'have heard' before 'hear'. Explanation:- 'the first time' phrase ke sath present tense me generally present perfect ka use kiya jaata hai kyunki iska indirect meaning hota hai aaj tak aisa nhi hua ye pehli baar hai. Joki perfect tense wala meaning hota hai.

questions.question: When the train pulled in at the station, it take Joseph some time to get off.
questions.solution: use 'took' instead of 'take'. Explanation:- kyunki 'when' conjunction and sentence ke meaning se pata chal rha hai ye dono actions past tense me likhe jayenge.

questions.question: He came on the bicycle in order that he may reach there in time.
options: he may reach there in time.
questions.solution: Use 'might' in place of 'may'. Explanation:- yahan main clause past me hai toh sub clause bhi past me likha jaayega.

questions.question: The article that she wrote for the last week's Sunday Supplement rightly criticises the abuse of mobile phones.
options: for the last week's Sunday Supplement
questions.solution: use 'criticised' instead of 'criticises'. Explanation:- yahan main clause past me hai toh sub clause bhi past me likha jaayega. Aur meaning ke according bhi yhan last week likhe gye article ki baat ho rhi hai.

questions.question: My daughter never would write to me so I don't know what she is doing.
options: I don't know what she is doing.
questions.solution: Use writes in place of would write. Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki –' meri daughter muje letter nhi likhti hai isliye…' ye meaning present ke habitual action ko refer kar rha hai isliye present indefinite tense use hoga.

questions.question: They were having a birthday party at home next week.
questions.solution: Use 'will have/are having/will be having/are going to have' in place of 'were having.' Explanation:- next week se pta chal rha hai ki action future me hoga. Note :- Iss sentence ke meaning ke according yhan 'will have/are having/will be having/are going to have' ye sab structures future dikhane ke liye use kiye jaa sakte hai. Aur 'have' verb ki form yhan possession ko dikhane ke liye ni balki 'organising' wala meaning de rhi hai isliye ye yhan stative verb nhi hai aur 'having' word me koi dikkat nhi hai.

questions.question: "Mrs. Pooja is very busy at the moment."  "All right. I had been waiting."
questions.solution: use 'will wait' instead of 'had been waiting'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'theek hai main wait karungi'.

questions.question: Sonia came to the meeting much later than the boss expected.
questions.solution: Use had expected in place of expected. Explanation:- 'later' comparative degree se pta chal rha ki yahan past ke 2 actions ke time ka comparison karna hai isliye 1st action yaani expectation wale action ko past perfect me likhna padega.

questions.question: We have not met  some of our friends  since six months.
questions.solution: use 'for' instead of 'since'. Explanation:- kyunki 'since' ka use 'point of time' ke liye kiya jaata hai aur 'for' ka use 'duration of time' ke liye.

questions.question: Nowadays, common people take interest in the manner in which they were governed.
questions.solution: use 'are governed' instead of 'were governed'. Explanation:- kyunki nowadays se pata chal rha hai ki sentence present me likha jaana chahiye. 'are governed' yhan passive form hai present indefinite tense ki. Note:- Nowdays word ke sath present continuous bhi aa sakta hai isliye 'take' ki jagah 'are taking' bhi sahi hota but ye koi error nhi hai kyuki iss sentence me present ka fact type meaning bhi nikal rha hai isliye 'take ' bhi theek hai.

questions.question: Smita lived in this house since she was five years old.
questions.solution: use 'has been living' instead of 'lived'. Explanation:- kyunki 'since' ke sath jab ek past ka action 'point of time' ka kaam kare toh main clause present perfect continuous tense me likha jaata hai.

questions.question: Since the trip to home was expensive I did not went home during the holidays.
options: was expensive I did not went
questions.solution: Use go in place of went. Explanation:- 'did' ke baad main verb ki base form aati hai. Note :- yahan 'since' wala rule isliye nahi lag rha hai kyunki yahan 'since' preposition nahi hai yahan ye conjunction hai jiska meaning 'kyunki' hai. Yahan sentence ka meaning ye hai ki - 'kyunki ghar jaane ki trip mehengi thi wo chhuttiyon me ghar nahi gya tha'.

questions.question: I visited my friend with whom I have made an appointment.
questions.solution: Use 'had made' instead of 'have made'. Explanation:- sentence past me hai aur appointment lene ka action pehle hua hai isliye yhan past perfect tense 'had made' use hoga.

questions.question: Suchitra will have  to wait another month  before she received  any reply to her letter.
questions.solution: use 'receives' instead of 'received'. Explanation:- kyunki agar main clause future tense me ho toh sub clause usually present tense me hota hai. Sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki - Suchitra ko ek month aur wait karna padega, use uske letter ka reply milne se pehle.

questions.question: In its August 1992 issue, the highly respected British Journal of Addiction describe three unusual cases of carrot dependence.
options: In its August 1992 issue, the highly respected British Journal of Addiction was describing three unusual cases of carrot dependence.
In its August 1992 issue, the highly respected British Journal of Addiction describing three unusual cases of carrot dependence.
In its August 1992 issue, the highly respected British Journal of Addiction described three unusual cases of carrot dependence.
In its August 1992 issue, the highly respected British Journal of Addiction has been described three unusual cases of carrot dependence.
questions.solution: use 'described' instead of 'describe'. Explanation:- kyunki yeh sentence past tense ka hai isliye described ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: He sees us coming, and unaware that we had learned of his treachery, greeted us with a smile.
options: He saw us come, and unaware that we had learned of his treachery, greets us with a smile.
He saw us coming, and unaware that we had learned of his treachery, greeted us with a smile.
He saw us coming, and unaware that we were learning of his treachery, greeted us with a smile.
He saw us coming, and unaware that we learned of his treachery, greeted us with a smile.
questions.solution: use 'saw' instead of 'sees'. Explanation:- kyunki sentence me aage 2 verb 'had learned' and 'greeted' past me likhi hain isliye meaning ke according 'saw' ka use kiya jaayega. Yhan meaning ye hai ki –' usne hume aate hue dekha aur iss baat se anjaan ki hume uski dhokhadhadi ka pta pehle hi chal gya tha, usne humein greet kiya tha'

questions.question: As long as there was corruption in India, there can be no progress.
questions.solution: use 'is' instead of 'was'. Explanation:- kyunki sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki jab tak India me corruption hai progress nahi ho sakti.

questions.question: The construction of the new business school is led to a sudden rise of population in our area.
options: a sudden rise of population in our area
questions.solution: use 'led to/has led to/is leading to' instead of 'is led'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan passive voice nahi active voice ka use hoga, kyunki sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki:- "naye business school ki construction ki wajah se area ki population me sudden rise aaya hai.

questions.question: When I was at school I found my class teacher to be the best mentor as she always have time to listen and guide.
options: as she always have time to listen and guide
questions.solution: use 'had' instead of 'have'. Explanation:- sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'past tense' use hoga.

questions.question: My brother lost  his job during the lockdown,  but he had got  a new job now.
questions.solution: use 'has' instead of 'had'. Explanation:- kyunki 'now' se pata chal raha hai ki 'present tense' use hoga. Note: Yahan wo 'main clause past - sub clause past' wala concept isliye apply nahi ho rha hai kyunki yahan coordinate conjunction 'but' use hua hai.

questions.question: The Prime Minister chair a high-level meeting with senior officials to review the Covid situation.
options: The Prime Minister chair a high-level meeting
questions.solution: use 'chaired' instead of 'chair'. Explanation:- kyunki 'the prime minister' subject singular hai toh 'chair' plural verb toh nahi aa sakti. 'chairs' bhi nahi aaayega kyunki yahan koi habitual action ki baat nahi ho rahi hai kisi particular meaning ki baat ho rahi hai.

questions.question: Cyclone Amphan roared into West Bengal on Wednesday leave behind a trail of devastation across a large area of the State.
questions.solution: use 'leaving' instead of 'leave'. Explanation:- kyunki meaning and grammar ke according yahan 'leave' verb ki nahi balki 'leaving' present participle ki zarurat hai. Eg. He went outside, slamming the door. (veh bahar chala gya, darwaja patak kar) Note :- waise yhan 'leave' ki jagah 'and left' lga ke bhi sentence theek kiya ja sakta hai.

questions.question: Please switch off all the lights  before you  are leaving the room.
questions.solution: use 'leave' instead of 'are leaving'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan meaning dena hai ki:- 'Room se bahar jaane se pehle, kripya saari lights band kar den. yahan kisi action ki continuity show nahi karni hai isliye continuous tense nhi aayega.

questions.question: All of us were a little nervous when we came into this room today.
options: when we came into this room today
questions.solution: No error. Explanation:- Note:- 'Today' ko dekh ke kuch students ko lgta hai ki past galat ho jaayega but aisa nhi hai. Example se samajho :- I watched a movie today. (maine aaj ek movie dekhi thi) ye sentence bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: Sh! Someone listens to our conversation.
questions.solution: use 'is listening' instead of 'listens'. Explanation:- kyunki 'sh!' word se pata chal raha hai ki speaker abhi current me chup hone ko keh raha hai kyunki use esa lagta hai ki koi unki baatein sun raha hai, na ki yahan koi habitual action btaya jaa raha hai. Isliye continuous tense ka use hoga.

questions.question: She misplaced her spectacles and now finding it difficult to read.
questions.solution: use 'and now finds or and now is finding' instead of 'finding'. Explanation:- kyunki grammar ke according finding (v1+ing) se pehle helping verb lagani zaruri hai aur sentence ka meaning ye dena hai ki 'usne apna chasma gum kar diya tha aur ab use read karne me problem ho rhi hai ya hoti hai.

questions.question: Three hours will have passed when the bell will ring.
questions.solution: use 'rings' instead of 'will ring'. Explanation:- kyunki 2 future tenses ek sath nahi likhe jaate aur condition waale part ko generally present tense me likhte hain.

questions.question: The concert has started when he reached the venue.
questions.solution: use 'had started/started' instead of 'has started'. Explanation:- 'when' conjunction se pta chal rha hai ki dono actions past me likhe jayenge. grammatically toh 'started' and 'had started' dono theek hain par prefer karne ki baat aaye toh meaning wise 'had started se better meaning aaayega. 'started' lgane se ye meaning aayega :- concert shuru hua tha jab wo venue par pahuncha tha. 'had started' lgane se ye meaning aayega - concert shuru ho chuka tha jab wo venue par pahuncha tha. Clearly yhan 'had started' lgane se better meaning aa rha hai.

questions.question: She is not as smart as I think at first.
questions.solution: use 'thought' instead of 'think'. Explanation:- kyunki 'at first' se pta chal rha hai ki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- "veh utni smart nahi hai jitna maine pehle socha tha. Isliye past tense ka use hoga.

questions.question: Freedom of expression meaning the right to express one's own convictions and beliefs.
questions.solution: use 'means' instead of 'meaning'. Explanation:- kyunki "v1+ing" main verb bina helping verb ke liye nahi aati aur hume yahan koi continuity nahi dikhani hai balki fact batana hai.

questions.question: My domestic help was taking ill the day I had a party in my house.
options: the day I had a party
questions.solution: use ' was taken ill' instead of 'was taking ill'. Explanation:- kyunki 'take ill' ek phrase hai jiska meaning hota hai achanak se bimaar pad jaana. aise phrase reading se hi pta chalte hain ya yaad hi karne padte hain.

questions.question: A Delhi bound aircraft has to make an emergency landing at Mumbai airport as a woman passenger suddenly developed a serious breathing problem.
questions.solution: use 'had' instead of 'has'. Explanation:- kyunki aage ke sentence ko padh kar pata chal raha hai ki past ka meaning dena hai. 'aircraft ko landing karni padi thi'

questions.question: Firecrackers have seized by the government went off while being defused on the banks of the river Ganga, in a town in West Bengal.
options: on the banks of the river Ganga
Firecrackers have seized by the government
in a town in West Bengal
questions.solution: Remove 'have seized' with 'seized'. Explanation:- kyunki 'fire crackers' subject ke liye main verb 'went off' hai na ki 'have seized' meaning se bhi dekhein toh 'fire crackers kisi ko seize nahi krenge, fire crackers seize kiye jayege' meaning ye dena hai ki 'government ke dwara seize kiye gaye firecrackers fatt gaye'. Yahan seized koi verb nahi 'fire crackers' noun ke liye adjective (past participle) ka kaam kar raha hai.

questions.question: A 12 year old archer was airlifted to Delhi when he met with an accident while practice for the Khelo India Games in Guwahati.
options: when he met with an accident
while practice for the Khelo India Games
questions.solution: use 'practising' instead of 'practice'. Explanation:- kyunki 'while' continuity ko show karta hai isliye iske baad 'practise' ko 'v1+ing' form me likha jaayega. while practising = while he was practising. Note:-Practice(noun) Practise(verb) Gerund ya present participle verb+ing se bante hain isliye spelling 'practising' hoti hai.

questions.question: Often hailed as one of the greatest industry leaders of India, Ratan Tata take across the reins of the company, leading from the front.
options: the greatest industry leaders from India,
Ratan Tata take across the reins of the company
questions.solution: use 'took over' instead of 'take across'. Explanation:- kyunki 'Ratan tata' singular subject hain toh 'take across' plural verb toh aaayega nahi aur ye koi habitual action nahi hai isliye past tense lagana meaning wise better rahega aur phrasal verb me bhi galti hai. take across - kisi vastu ko kisi cheez ke dusri chhor (end) tak le jana. take over - kisi company etc. ka control apne hath me lena.

questions.question: I don't think I meet him before.
questions.solution: use 'I have met' instead of 'meet'. Explanation:- kyunki 'before' adverb ke sath perfect tense ka use hoga. Meaning yeh dena hai ki:- mujhe nahi lagta main isse pehle kabhi mila hun.

questions.question: 'Plogging' is an international trend, in which someone picking up the trash while jogging or brisk walking.
questions.solution: use 'picks' instead of 'picking'. Explanation:- kyunki 'v1+ing' main verb ke nahi aati aur yahan waise bhi hume yahan ek definition ek fact btana hai isliye present indefinite tense ka use hoga.

questions.question: We will have to walk now since we had missed the bus.
questions.solution: use 'have missed' instead of 'had missed'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan koi past ke do actions ka comparison nahi karna hai yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki:- "ab hume chalna padega kyunki hum apni bus miss kar chuke hain. Note :- 'since' yahan preposition nahi hai yahan ye conjuction hai jiska matlab hai 'kyunki'

questions.question: When they started, they had great ideas but lack the business know-how.
questions.solution: use 'lacked' instead of 'lack'. Explanation:- kyunki sentence me past ka meaning dena hai:- 'unke paas business kaise chalaya jaata hai knowledge ki kami thi'. Note :- 'business know how' ek phrase hai jiska matlab hai 'knowledge of how to run a business'

questions.question: Are you having your own transport to go home from work?
questions.solution: use 'do you have' instead of 'are you having'. Explanation:- kyunki 'have' jab possession ko dikhata hai toh wo ek stative verb hota hai 'Stative verbs' esi verbs hoti hain jinko generally ing form me use nahi kiya jaata hai, jaise- hear, look, see, feel, smell, love, like, believe, possess, have etc.

questions.question: It is reported that she has win a prize money of ten lakhs at a reality show.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence present me hai aur 'has' helping verb ke baad verb ki third form aayegi isliye D 'has won' sahi hai.

questions.question: I don't wear the sunglasses at the moment.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'at the moment' hint hai ki yhan present continuous ka use hoga isliye D 'I am not wearing' sahi hai.

questions.question: The Karaoke programme was planned by the club was a grand success.
options: has been planned by the club
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan planned verb nhi past participle (adjective) ka kaam karega jo programme noun ke liye aaya hai kyuki verb 'was' aage di hui hai. isliye D sahi hai.

questions.question: The man was convicted for murder by the jury but he is not committed it.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Convict hone wala action past indefinite me likha gya hai aur ab uss se bhi pehle ki baat karni hai aur past of past ke liye past perfect ka use hota hai isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: He had given me that book in 1999.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yhan koi past ke 2 action ka comparison nhi ho rha hai. Past ka point of time 'in 1999' diya hai isliye past indefinite ka use hoga aur D sahi hai.

questions.question: Our guests arrived; they are sitting in the garden.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'guests aa chuke hain wo garden me baithe hai' isliye grammar and meaning ke according yhan present perfect ka use hoga aur B sahi hai.

questions.question: Abu said that he saw the picture.
options: he will have seen the picture
he would have seen the picture
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yhan main clause past me hai to sub clause bhi past me aayega aur ye kaam pehle hi ho chuka tha isliye past perfect wala D sahi hai

questions.question: During my Goa tour, I had visited beaches in Vasco, Baga and Vagator.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan koi past ke 2 actions ka comparison nhi hai. Past ka ek fact btaya ja rha hai isliye past indefinite tense wala A option sahi hai. Note :- waise yhan 'have visited' bhi galat nhi hai but 'during my Goa tour' ek type se past ka time dikha rha hai isliye past indefinite lagana prefer karenge

questions.question: I have reached the hotel, by the time you call me.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yhan meaning ye dena hai ki - 'Main hotel pahunch chuka hounga jab tak tum muje call karoge' isliye meaning hai tense ke according yhan future perfect tense wala C sahi hai.

questions.question: The bus is now full of passengers; it will leave soon.
questions.solution: Explanation:- A option isliye nhi hoga kyuki ye koi planned official action nhi hai. B,C,D grammatically theek hain but meaning wise C best hai . Note:- 'is leaving' lgane se meaning aayega ye jaldi hi chal rhi hai. 'is going to leave' lgane se meaning aayega – ye jaldi hi chalne wali hai. 'has to leave' lgane se meaning aayega – isko jaldi hi chalna padega.

questions.question: When the weather is hot, I will like to eat ice cream.
questions.solution: Explanation :- yhan habitual action ki baat ho rhi hai isliye present indefinite wala C sahi hai.

questions.question: By the time his friends woke up, he had already begun his journey.
questions.solution: Explanation:- past perfect me 'had +v3' ka use hota hai isliye question me diya gya 'had already begun' sahi hai.

questions.question: His last trip around the world taking a toll on his health.
questions.solution: Explanation:- V3 and V1+ ing bina helping verb ke nhi aati isliye B and C galat hai. yhan koi habitual action ki baat nhi ho rhi isliye D galat hai. yhan past ke action ki baat ho rhi hai isliye meaning ke according yhan A 'took a toll' sahi hai.

questions.question: Sheila always went to get ice cream with her dad on Tuesdays.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan present indefinite tense option me hi nhi hai isliye ye clear hai ki yhan past hi habit ki baat karni hai aur past ki habit past indefinite tense ke sath adverb of frequency laga ke dikhai ja sakti hai isliye D sahi hai.

questions.question: You are failed to be achieved high enough sales to earn a bonus this month.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Have' helping verb ke baad V3 aati hai isliye C galat hai. You ke sath plural verb aati hai isliye D galat hai. Yhan future ka meaning nhi dena hai isliye A galat hai. Meaning and grammar ke according B 'you failed...' sahi hai.

questions.question: Doctor Bayley tripped under some large roots and cuts her head on a rock.
options: tripped over some large roots and cut
tripped over and above some large roots and cut
tripped upon some larger roots and cuts
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yhan meaning dena hai ki- Doctor Bayley kisi badi root me paer fas ke trip ho gyi unke forhead pe injury aa gyi' iss meaning ke 'tripped over' phrasal verb ka use hoga aur dono verb past me ayengi isliye B sahi hai.

questions.question: Desert flowers bloom whenever it raining, and the sight can be rewarding
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'desert flowers bloom karte hain jab bhi barsaat hoti hai' yani yhan ek fact btana hai isliye present indefinite tense wala A sahi hai.

questions.question: He indicated that a vigorous recovery programme was being carried out; 90,000 reminders had been issued and thousands of summons sent.
options: has been issued and thousands of summons sent
has been issued and thousands of summonses sent
had been issued and thousands of summonses were sent
questions.solution: Explanation:- Noun chapter ke concept ke according 'Summonses' sahi plural noun hai aur verb passive me aayegi isliye 'were sent' ka use hoga. Isliye D sahi hai.

questions.question: In the nineteenth century, many new ideas about education and learning were being emerged.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan past ka point of time hai isliye past indefinite tense ka use hoga aur 'emerge' ek happening verb hai isliye iska passive nhi hoga. Isliye grammar and meaning ke according D sahi hai.

questions.question: My uncle is doing business in Hyderabad for the last 10 years.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'for + duration' ke sath present perfect continuous ka use hoga. isliye A sahi hai.

questions.question: He was knowing her for a long time before he finally married her.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Before ke aage clause past use hua hai isliye yhan past ke 2 actions ka comparison hai. isliye past perfect wala C 'had known' sahi hai. Note :- 'know' stative verb hai iski ing form nhi use hogi.

questions.question: I don't think we can talk to him at all. He wasn't listening.
questions.solution: Explanation:- will modal ke baad base form hi aa sakti hai isliye D galat hai. Yhan past ke actions ka comparison nhi hai isliye C galat hai. Meaning ye dena hai ki - 'wo sunta hi nhi hai' matlb uski habit btani hai isliye present indefinite tense wala B sahi hai.

questions.question: These days my parents are been taking great care of my health and want me to eat nuts and seeds, which are rich in vitamins and minerals.
questions.solution: Explanation- 'these days' hint hai ki present continuous tense use hoga isliye A sahi hai.

questions.question: The accused has been tortured before he was brought to the court.
questions.solution: Explanation- yhan past ke 2 actions ka comparison kiya ja rha hai aur subject 'the accused' receiver hai isliye passive voice chahiye. Isliye D 'had been tortured' sahi hai.

questions.question: One of the rooms in the new house had not yet been completed.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'yet' se hint mil rha hai ki present perfect tense ka use hoga. Room receiver banega isliye voice passive aayegi. Subject 'one' isliye verb singular aayegi. Inn sab points ke according C sahi hai.

questions.question: I practised for the debate; that's why I am late.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki - 'main debate ke liye practice kar rha tha isliye late ho gya' isliye meaning ke according yhan C sahi hai.

questions.question: The young man lifts weights at the gym when he pulled a muscle.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki -' young man weight utha rha tha jab uski muscle khich gyi' isliye past continuous wale A 'was lifting' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I have been working with children before, so I know what to expect.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki -' main bacchon ke sath pehle kaam kar chuka hun....' isliye B 'have worked' sahi hai.

questions.question: The Arabian Sea region is very important for India as several major ports are locating there.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki ' bhut saare major ports wha located hain' isme koi action nhi ho rha yhan 'are' linking verb hai aur 'located' past participle (adjective) ki tarah kaam karega. isliye B 'are located' sahi hai.

questions.question: After walking a few steps in the forest, our guide sensing some sort of movement in the foliage behind us.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki - ' humare guide ne kuch movement sense kari...' isliye meaning ke according past indefinite tense ka use hoga aur active voice lagegi isliye B 'sensed' sahi hai.

questions.question: One evening, when father was coming home from work, I played in the front garden.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan ye dono past ke actions sath me continuity me the isliye past continuous tense ka use hoga. isliye D 'was playing' sahi hai.

questions.question: His employees were asking him for a raise for a long time now.
options: are asking him of a raise
have been asking him for a raise
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan 'for + duration' structure ka use hua hai isliye present perfect continuous tense ka use hoga isliye D sahi hai.

questions.question: Many people are becoming aware of the advantages of preventive health care nowadays
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'nowadays' hint hai ki present continuous ka use hoga aur 'aware' ke sath 'of' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye question me diya gya structure sahi hai.

questions.question: Don't stay in school after 2 p.m. All the teachers have been leaving by then.
questions.solution: Explanation- 'by then' = (by +time) hint hai aur meaning ye dena hai ki -' uss samay tak sab teachers ja chuke honge' isliye yhan future perfect tense ka use hoga. B 'will have left' sahi hai.

questions.question: Shyamalan's movie 'The Sixth Sense' starring Bruce Willis was a great success but doesn't win all Academy Award as expected.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki :- ' lekin iss movie ne koi academy award nhi jita ' meaning and grammar ke structure ke according B sahi hai.

questions.question: I walked around the quiet lakeside for hours, (a)/ watching birds and enjoying the cool breeze, (b)/ and then I get on a late-evening bus to Delhi(c)/. No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'get on' with 'got on'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'wo lakeside ghuma kuch hours uske baad usne delhi ke liye bus pakad li', toh sentence mein 'bus' mein chadne wala koi habitual action nahi, aur 'walked' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, toh ghumne wala aur bus pakadne wala dono action past mein hue honge, isliye yahan 'get' ki past form 'got' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Medical journals told doctors (a)/about new global health studies (b)/that highlight important disease patterns (c)/and their possible treatments. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'told doctors' with 'tell doctors'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'told' se pata chal raha ki 'medical journals' ne past mein doctor ko bataya, lekin medical journals waali baat ek fact ki tarah use hogi jiska matlab hoga ki 'medical journals doctors ko batate hai global health studies ke baare mein', isliye 'medical journals' waali baat past ka koi action nahi balki ek fact ki tarah use hogi, isliye iss baat ko present indefinite tense mein likhna padega, isliye 'told' ki jagah par 'tell' sahi hoga, 'journals' plural hai jiske according plural verb 'tell' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This is indeed the first (a)/ time in my professional journey that I hear (b)/ such a powerful and inspiring speech (c)/ from a young entrepreneur. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'hear' with 'have heard'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'hear' ki jagah par 'have heard' aayega kyunki 'indeed the first time, the second time' iss type ke phrase mein pehle se lekar ab tak ki baat convey hoti hai, matlab past se lekar ab tak. Toh past se lekar present ki baat karne ke liye present perfect tense ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'have heard' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the bus reached (a)/ the crowded marketplace, it take (b)/ Priya a few minutes (c)/ to gather her luggage and step outside carefully. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'take' with 'took'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'when' se pata chal raha ki dono action sath mein hue honge. Agar bus crowded place pe past mein pahuchi, toh luggage utthane wala action bhi past mein hua hoga, isliye yahan 'take' ki past form 'took' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Usually, Neeraj hasn't (a)/ attend weekend cultural workshops (b)/ organized by the community center (c)/ because of his tight work schedule. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'hasn't' with 'doesn't'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'usually' se pata chal raha ki yeh neeraj ka habitual action hai, aur habitual action ko humesha present indefinite tense mein likha jata hai, kyunki sentence negative bhi hai, isliye isse 'do/does' se banana padega, 'Neeraj' singular noun ke liye 'does' singular H.V. ka use hoga, isliye 'hasn't' ki jagah par 'doesn't' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: They are having (a)/ a grand family gathering with relatives coming (b)/ from different cities at their farmhouse next week (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: No error. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'next week' se pata chal raha ki koi kaam future mein hoga, toh present continuous tense bhi future ko represent karta hai, isliye yeh 'no error' hoga. 'next Monday, next Sunday, next week' yeh future waale words 'continuous tense se represent kiya jaa sakte hai'.

questions.question: They are always arguing (a)/ about tiny and meaningless issues (b)/ which makes everyone around uncomfortable. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: No error. Explanation:-Agar 'always' ke sath aisa koi action likha ho, bhale hee wo habitual action ho, agar wo irritating ho toh usse continuous tense mein likhte hai, isliye yeh sentence 'no error' hai.

questions.question: "The principal is talking to some (a)/ parents in her office (b)/ at the moment," "Alright, I had been waiting (c)/ until she gets free." (d)
questions.solution: replace 'had been waiting' with 'will wait'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'had been waiting' ki jagah par 'will wait' aayega kyunki sentence mein bataya ki 'principal abhi baat kar rahi hai kuch parents se', toh principal waali baat ka jawab hoga ki 'mein wait karunga jab tak wo free nahi ho jaati', naa ki 'mein uska wait kar raha tha', toh 'wait' karne wala action sentence ke according future tak hoga, isliye yahan 'will wait' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I am working on this research (a)/ project continuously for the last three weeks so (b)/ I need 2 days' leave. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'am working' with 'have been working'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'for + duration' se pata chal raha ki yeh kaam past se lekar abhi tak ho raha hai, jiske liye present perfect continuous tense ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'am working' ki jagah par 'have been working' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He reminded his son (a)/ to close the main gate properly (b)/ before leaving for school, but (c)/ he forget  to do that. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'he forget' with 'he forgot'. Explanation:-Sentence mein past ke single time action ki baat ho rahi hai, sentence mein bataya ki 'usne apne ladke se kaha tha gate lagake ke jaane ki, lekin wo bhool gaya', toh 'reminded' se pata chal raha ki past mein kaha tha, toh bhoolne wala action bhi past mein hoga, aur present indefinite tense se uska habitual action ho jaayega jo ki galat hoga, isliye yahan past indefinite tense ka use hoga, isliye 'forget' ki 2nd form 'forgot' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She reached the audition hall (a)/ much later than she planned (b)/ because of heavy traffic. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: put 'had' before 'planned'. Explanation:-Sentence mein do past ke action ka comparison karna hai, 'later' se bhi pata chal raha ki pahuchne wala action baad mein hoga aur 'planned' karna wala action pehle, isliye 'plan' waale action ko past perfect tense aur 'reached' wala action past indefinite tense mein likha jaayega, toh 'planned' se pehle 'had' likhne se past perfect tense mein badal jaayega, isliye 'had planned' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Did he arranged (a)/ the entire surprise celebration by himself (b)/ since nobody else knew about your birthday plan until the moment you walked in? (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'did he arranged' with 'did he arrange'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'arranged' ki jagah par 'arrange' aayega kyunki 'do/does/did' ke baad ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'did he arrange' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As it has been snowing continuously (a)/ since the last three hours, (b)/ the tourists are staying inside their cottages (c)/ to avoid the harsh weather. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'since' with 'for'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'since' ki jagah par 'for' aayega kyunki 'since' ka use 'point of time' dikhaane ke liye hota jabki 'for' ka use 'duration of time' dikhaane ke liye. sentence mein 'last three hours' se pata chal raha ki duration dikhaana hai, isliye yahan 'for' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The heavy overnight snowfall (a)/ in the entire mountain region blocked (b)/ important highways and (c)/ freezing water pipelines in several remote villages. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'freezing water' with 'froze water'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'freezing' ki jagah par 'froze' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hoga 'heavy snowfall ne mountain ko blocked kar diya aur paani ko jama diya', toh 'freezing' v1+ing bina helping ke nahi aa sakti, 'block' aur 'freeze' verb 'and' conjunction se jude hai toh dono verb same form mein aayegi, kyunki yeh past ke action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'freeze' ko past indefinite tense mein likhna padega, isliye 'freeze' ki 2nd form 'froze' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She has been trying to learn classical music (a)/ for last summer, (b)/ but her schedule often gets too hectic (c)/ due to office work. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'for' with 'since'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'for' ki jagah par 'since' aayega kyunki 'since' ka use 'point of time' dikhaane ke liye hota jabki 'for' ka use 'duration of time' dikhaane ke liye. 'last summer' se pata chal raha ki 'point of time ki baat ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'since last summer' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: How long are you preparing (a)/ for your civil services exam (b)/ with this early-morning study routine of yours? (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'are you preparing' with 'have you been preparing'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'are you preparing' ki jagah par 'have you been preparing' aayega kyunki 'how long' waisa he meaning deta hai jaise 'for + duration', ki kabse aisa kar rahe ho wala sense. Isliye 'how long' ke sath bhi perfect continous tense ka use karenge, isliye yahan 'have you been preparing' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: These days, heritage sites in major tourist cities (a)/ are protected by strict laws (b)/ so that valuable monuments and ancient sculptures (c)/ do not being damaged by careless visitors. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'do not being damaged' with 'are not damaged'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'by careless visitors' se pata chal raha ki dusra clause passive voice mein likha, jiske according verb bhi passive voice mein aayegi, isliye passive voice mein 'are not damaged' sabse sahi answer hoga. sentence ka matlab hoga 'monuments aur sculptures damage naa kiye jaayein visitors ke dwara'.

questions.question: Rohan lived in this apartment (a)/ since his elder sister moved abroad (b)/ for her higher studies (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'lived' with 'has been living'. Explanation:- 'since' ke sath past ka koi action point of time ki tarah kaam karne lag jaaye, toh wahan pe perfect yaa perfect continuous tense ka use karte hai, sentence mein clear nahi hai ki kaam khatam hua hai, isliye perfect continuous tense ka use karenge, isliye 'has been living' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Last month when I visited the city (a)/ hospital for my routine check-up, I (b)/ consulted the senior cardiologist (c)/ with whom I have booked an appointment. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'have booked' with 'had booked'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'have' ki jagah par 'had' aayega kyunki sentence mein clear hai ki 'visit' aur 'consult' wala kaam past mein hua hai, toh obvious baat hai 'appointment book' wala action toh usse bhi pehle hua hoga, isliye 'appointment book' waale action ko past of past yaani ki past perfect tense mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'had booked' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: My cousin is practising yoga every morning in the community park (a)/ under the guidance of a certified trainer (b)/ since January to improve her strength, flexibility, and overall mental well-being. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'is practicing' with 'has been practising'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'since January' se 'point of time' pata chal raha ki 'uski cousin January se yoga practice kar rahi hai', toh 'since + point of time' ke sath perfect continuous/ perfect tense ka use hoga, kyunki practice wala kaam chal raha hai, isliye isse perfect continuous mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'has been practising' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The university will not release the final merit list (a)/ for the postgraduate admissions (b)/ until the examination committee will verify (c)/ the documents submitted by the applicants. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'will verify' with 'verifies'. Explanation:-Sentence mein do future tense ka use sath mein galat hai, sentence mein jo condition wala part hai usse present indefinite tense mein likhte hai, toh sentence mein 'verify' karne wala part condition hai, isliye isse present indefinite tense mein likhenge, kyunki 'examination committee' singular hai jiske liye singular verb 'verifies' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In its January 1984 edition (a)/ the National Geographic magazine explain (b)/ how ancient cave paintings were discovered (c)/ deep inside a remote valley in France. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'explain' with 'explained'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'explain' ki jagah par 'explained' aayega kyunki sentence mein '1984 edition' se pata chal raha ki yeh magazine jab launch hui hogi tabhi isne explain kiya hoga cave painting ke baare mein, toh 'explain' karne wala past mein hua hai, isliye yaha past indefinite tense 'explained' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: My parents visit the city hospital (a) / for a routine health examination (b) / this coming Monday morning (c) / No error. (d)
questions.solution: put 'will' before 'visit'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'this coming Monday' se pata chal ki aane waale Monday ko wo doctor ko visit karenge, toh yeh action future mein hoga, isliye isse future indefinite tense mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'will visit' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The rapid construction of luxury high-rise apartments in our city (a) / is led to an unexpected surge in rental prices (b) / forcing many middle-income families to move towards the outskirts (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'is led' with 'has led to/is leading to/led to'. Explanation:-Yeh sentence active passive voice pe based hai, yahan 'rapid construction' subject hai jo ki 'unexpected surge' ko lead karne ka doer hai, isliye yahan active voice ki jarurat hai, tense yahan koi bhi use kiya jaa sakta hai 'has led to/is leading to/ led to', yahan sabhi tense sahi hai bas meaning alag alag denge.

questions.question: Aarav had frustrated with his elder brother (a) / ever since they had a heated argument (b) / about their father's property last month (c) / No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'had frustrated' with 'has been frustrated'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'had frustrated' ki jagah par 'has been frustrated' aayega kyunki 'since + point of time' ke sath present perfect/present perfect continuous tense ka use hota hai, sentence mein kehna hai ki 'Aarav frustrated hai', isliye yahan perfect continuous nahi aayega, active aur passive wala meaning bhi nahi aayega, isliye yahan present perfect aayega jo ki linking verb se bana hai, toh 'has been frustrated' aayega jisme 'been' linking verb hai 'frustrated' adjective hai.

questions.question: During the recession last year, our company laid off many employees (a) / and my close colleague lost his position too (b) / but he had secured a far better opportunity now (c) / at a multinational firm abroad. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'had secured' with 'has secured'. Explanation: Sentence ka main context past tense mein hai ("During the recession last year", "laid off", "lost his position"). Lekin "now" ka use present time ko indicate karta hai, isliye past perfect "had secured" galat hai. "Now" ke saath present perfect tense "has secured" use hona chahiye, jo batata hai ki usne abhi tak ek better opportunity secure kar li hai.

questions.question: In the chemistry lab, the students measured the chemicals (a) / mixed them according to the procedure (b) / and record their observations carefully (c) / in their lab notebooks. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'record' with 'recorded'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'measured', 'mixed' karne wala action past mein bataya hai, agar yeh action past mein hue hai, toh 'record' karne wala action bhi past mein hoga. Toh yahan parallelism follow hoga, isliye 'record' verb ki 2nd form 'recorded' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: All of us felt relieved (a) / when the train finally reached (b) / the crowded station early this morning after that long and tiring overnight journey (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: No error

questions.question: Before you (a) / leave to board an international flight (b) / you made sure that you (c)/ have kept your passport and boarding pass (d)
questions.solution: replace 'made' with 'should make'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'made' ki jagah par 'should make' aayega, kyunki sentence ek advice ke taur pe hai, Lekin 'made sure' se matlab hoga 'tumne pakka kiya tha', jo meaning ke according galat hai. sentence mein 'tumhe pakka kar lena chahiye' wala meaning chahiye, jiske liye yahan 'you should make sure' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Rashmi dropped her laptop accidentally (a)/ during the project meeting, (b)/ and now she worrying (c)/ about losing all her important presentation files. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'worrying' with 'is worried/ is worrying'. Explanation:-Sentence mein laptop girna past mein hua aur pareshan abhi ho rahi hai, isme koi dikkat nahi hai. sentence ka matlab hai 'rashmi se galti se laptop gir gaya tha aur wo pareshan hai/ pareshan ho rahi hai', sentence ke according 'pareshan hai/ pareshan ho rahi hai' dono meaning sahi hai, toh 'pareshan hai' ke liye ' she is worried', aur 'pareshan ho rahi hai' ke liye ' she is worrying'. Toh meaning ke according 'is worried/ is worrying' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: By the time the university will publish (a)/ the semester result on its website, (b)/ all students will have completed their internship. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'will publish' with 'publishes'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'will publish' ki jagah par 'publish' aayega kyunki 'by the time' se pata chal raha ki, yahan future ke 2 action ka comparison karna hai. un dono mein se jo pehle hoga usse 'future perfect' mein aur dusre ko 'present indefinite' mein. Toh sentence mein 'university ka result' baad mein publish hoga, isliye isse present indefinite mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'publishes' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When my mother has finished (a)/ cooking lunch yesterday afternoon, (b)/ we had already set the dining table (c)/ and prepared fresh lemonade for everyone. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'has finished' with 'finished'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'has finished' ki jagah par 'finished' aayega kyunki 'yesterday' se pata chal raha ki yeh past ka action hai, toh yahan present perfect ki jagah par 'past indefinite' tense ka use hoga. isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form 'finished' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The new hill-station route was not as smooth as I expected (a)/ and the narrow bends and constant landslides (b)/ made the drive even more difficult (c)/. No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'expected' with 'had expected'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'expected' ki jagah pe 'had expected' aayega kyunki kisi cheez ki 'expectation, planning' uss kaam se pehle hoti hai, kyunki sentence past mein hai aur 'expectation' usse pehle hogi matlab past of past, jiske liye past perfect tense ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'had expected' sabse sahi answer hoga. Note: 'plan, expect' verb mein agar past ke action likhe ho toh yeh generally past perfect mein likhi jaati hai.

questions.question: Basic human dignity (a)/ meaning that every individual is treated with respect(b)/ regardless of their background or social status (c)/ in every part of the community. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'meaning' with 'means'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'basic human dignity' subject hai jisko verb ki jarurat hai 'meaning' agar verb hai toh 'v1+ing' bina helping verb ke galat hogi, sentence mein 'basic human dignity' ke liye ek fact bataya jaa raha hai, jiske liye present indefinite tense ka use karenge, isliye yahan 'means' present indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While travelling by train to Delhi (a)/ one of the passengers was taking ill (b)/ due to extreme heat and dehydration (c)/ causing the train to halt for emergency assistance. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'was taking ill' with 'was taken ill'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'was taking ill' ki jagah par 'was taken ill' aayega kyunki 'took ill' phrasal verb hoti hai, jisse passive voice mein use karte hai, jiska matlab 'achaanak se bemaar ho jana', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'was taken ill' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A London-bound train has to stop at a remote station (a)/ when the conductor noticed smoke rising(b)/ from one of the coaches. (c) No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'has to' with 'had to'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'has to' ki jagah par 'had to' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'ek London bound train ko rukna pada jab conductor ne smoke uthte hue dekha', toh 'has to' ka matlab hoga 'karna padega', aur 'had to' ka matlab 'karna pada', toh sentence mein past ke single time action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'had to stop' 'train ko rukna pada' wala matlab sahi hoga, isliye yahan 'had to stop' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Celebrated as one of the most dedicated surgeons in the hospital (a)/ Dr. Mehta take charge of the emergency unit (b)/ when multiple accident victims arrived late at night. (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'take' with 'took'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'take' ki jagah par 'took' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'victims arrived late at night' se pata chal raha ki victims past mein aaye honge, toh 'Dr. Mehta' ne bhi emergency unit ka charge past mein shambhala hoga, isliye yahan 'took' past indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I don't think that (a)/ I meet this neighbour's son earlier (b)/ though his face seems slightly familiar (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'meet' with 'have met'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'meet' ki jagah par 'have met' aayega, kyunki 'meet' present indefinite tense se habitual action show hoga, lekin yeh koi habitual action nahi hai. sentence ka matlab hai 'mujhe nahi lagta mein aaj se pehle kabhi iss padosi ke bacche se mila hoo', toh past se lekar abhi tak ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan present perfect tense ka use hoga, isliye 'have met' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Cyber-bullying is a punishable act (a)/ in which a person sending threatening messages (b)/ to individuals online. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'sending' with 'sends'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'sending' ki jagah par 'sends' aayega kyunki sentence mein bataya gaya action koi contunuity mein nahi balki ek fact ke tarah bataya gaya hai ki 'cyber-bullying is punishable act hai jisme ek person threatening messages bhejta hai', toh facts ke liye 'present indefinite tense' ka use karte hai, isliye singular subject ke according singular verb 'sends' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: We need to book a taxi now (a)/ since we had missed the last metro (b)/ and standing here any longer (c)/ will only waste more time. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'had missed' with 'have missed'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'had' ki jagah pe 'have' aayega kyunki 'had missed' past perfect tense ka use past ke do action ko compare karne ke liye karte hai, isliye yahan past perfect galat hoga. sentence mein past ke action ka effect present mein dikhaana hai, jiske liye present perfect tense ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'have missed' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Was your mother liking the new ethnic collection (a)/ displayed in the festive season sale (b)/ at the pacific mall? (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'was your mother liking' with 'did your mother like'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'was…..liking' ki jagah par 'did…..like' aayega kyunki 'like' ek static verb hoti hai aur ise 'ing' mein likhna avoid karte hai, toh 'like' static verb mein likhenge toh phir 'was' ki jagah 'did' karna padega, kyunki 'was' ke baad 'v3' yaa 'ing' ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'did your mother like' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It is believed that he has achieve remarkable success in the field of renewable energy through years of research.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Option A nahi hoga kyunki 'will' model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai. Option B aur C bhi galat honge kyunki 'had' aur 'has' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai. Option D sahi answer hoga kyunki 'has' ke verb ki 3rd form use hui hai.

questions.question: Fresh water constantly is flowing from the snow-covered mountains into the valley, creating a peaceful and scenic environment for tourists.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option A 'flows' sahi hoga kyunki jo action continuously chalta rehta hai, usse fact ki tarah use karte hai jiske liye present indefinite tense ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'flows' option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The museum has been closed for last winter due to renovation work and is expected to reopen soon for tourists.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option B sahi hoga kyunki sentence mein bataya ki museum 'last winter' se band hai, toh 'last winter' yahan 'point of time' ki tarah likha hai jiske sath 'since' ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'since last winter' option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She doesn't study for her exams right now because she is feeling unwell and needs some rest.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'doesn't study' nahi hoga kyunki isse matlab niklega ki wo padhti nahi hai, lekin sentence mein 'right now' se pata chal raha ki abhi nahi padh rahi, toh sentence mein temperory action dikhaana hai, isliye yahan present continuous tense 'is not studying' sabse sahi answer hoga. option C aur D past ki baat kar rahe isliye galat honge.

questions.question: The newly constructed bridge, was completed last month, has already become a major route for daily commuters.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein agar 'was completed' ko verb bana denge toh 'has already become' verb ko subject nahi milega, isliye 'bridge' subject ki verb 'has become' hogi aur yahan 'was completed' verb nahi aayegi, iski jagah par 'adjective' likhenge kyunki 'bridge' kuch complete nahi kar raha balki bridge ko complete kiya jaa raha hai, isliye yahan past participle 'completed' sahi hoga, sentence mein 'completed last month' bridge ke liye adjective ka kaam karega, toh diye gaye options mein se 'completed last month' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: They had shifted to a new apartment last December because their old building was under renovation.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'last december' likha hai jisse pata chal raha past ka point of time hai, jiske liye past indefinite tense ka use karenge. Isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form 'shifted' option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The children finished their homework and they are now playing happily in the park behind our house.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'finished' galat nahi hai lekin 'no substution.' Ka option nahi hai aur sentence mein bataya ki 'bacchon ne apna kaam khatam kar liya aur ab wo khel rahe hai', toh sentence mein past ke action ka effect present mein dikhaana hai, jo sentence mein bhi bataya ki 'ab wo khel rahe hai', isliye yahan present perfect tense ka use hoga, toh diye gaye options mein se option C 'have finished' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I will finish this important report by the time the management arrives for the morning briefing.
options: will be finishing this important report
will have finished this important report
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'by the time' ka matlab hai 'jab tak', sentence mein future ke 2 action ka comparison karna hai, unn dono mein jo kaam pehle hoga usse 'future perfect' mein aur dusre ko 'present indefinite' tense mein likhenge, toh 'important report' ka kaam 'management' ke aane se pehle hoga, isliye isse future perfect tense mein likhenge, toh diye gaye options mein se option C mein future perfect tense 'will have finished this important report' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The sky is getting darker, it_____in a few minutes.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein future ko represent karna hai jiske liye 'is going' aur infinitive ka structure follow hota hai, isliye diye gaye option mein se option B 'is going to rain' sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: Every time the school bell rings for the lunch break, the students will rush quickly towards the canteen to buy snacks.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein ek habitual action bataya hai, jiske liye present indefinite tense ka use karnege, toh diye gaye options mein se option A 'the students rush' present indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: By the time the police arrived at the crime scene, the thieves escaped with all the expensive jewellery and electronic items.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'by the time' ka structure follow ho raha jisme yaa toh 2 past ke action aate hai, yaa future ke 2 action. Toh sentence mein past ke 2 action ki baat ho rahi hai, toh jo action pehle hota hai usse 'past perfect tense' mein likhte hai, aur jo action baad mein hota hai usse 'past indefinite tense' mein. Toh sentence mein 'thieves' police ke aane se pehle bhaag gaye, isliye isse past perfect mein likhenge, toh diye gaye options mein option A 'the thieves had escaped' past perfect sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Last winter, due to the severe cold wave, many water pipes bursting in the residential colony, creating a major inconvenience for the families.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'last winter' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye option B, C aur D galat honge, isliye option A 'many water pipes burst' sabse sahi answer hoga. Note: kuch verb aise hoti hai jinki verb ki 1st,2nd,3rd form same hoti hai, jaise 'burst, cut, put etc.'

questions.question: In her school days, she use to participate in every annual cultural event and often won prizes for her classical dance performances.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'in her school days' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, agar option mein verb ki 2nd form hoti, toh wo chal jaati, lekin aisa koi option nahi hai. isliye yahan 'used to' ka use karenge jiska baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye diye gaye options mein 'used to participate' option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Despite traveling across many countries and meeting countless inspiring people, Raj never meet such a generous host again in his life.
options: never met such a generous host
never meets such a generous host
had never meet such a generous host
will never met such a generous host
questions.solution: Explanation:-Option C aur D grammartically galat hai. aur sentence mein koi habitual action nahi, isliye option B galat hoga. isliye option A sahi jisse meaning aayega 'Raj kabhi dubara us generous host se nahi mila'

questions.question: Despite being warned repeatedly about reckless driving, the delivery rider is failed to follow the traffic rules and met with a serious accident last night.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'met' verb aur 'last night' se pata chal raha ki past ke action ki baat ho rahi hai. kyunki uska accident past mein hua, toh usne 'rules' ko follow past mein nahi kiya hoga, isliye yahan 'follow' karne wala action bhi 'past indefinite tense' mein likhenge, toh verb ki 2nd form 'followed' sahi hoga, isliye diye gaye options mein se option B 'failed to follow' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the judge announced the surprising verdict in the crowded courtroom, his eyes grow wide as he understand what it meant for his future.
options: was grown wide as he understand
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'announced' verb se pata chal raha ki verdict past mein di hogi, aur 'when' se pata chal raha ki dono action sath mein honge, toh 'eyes grow' wala action bhi 'past indefinite tense' mein hoga, isliye diye gaye options mein se option A 'grew wide as he understood' past indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This automatic streetlight switches on when the sky getting dark and helps pedestrians walk safely during late evenings.
options: when the sky has been getting dark
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai 'yeh streetlight apne aap jal jaati hai jab sky dark hone lagta hai', toh yeh baat sentence mein ek fact ki tarah use ho rahi hai, aur fact batane ke liye present indefinite tense ka use karte hai, toh diye gaye options mein se option B 'when the sky gets dark' present indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The report stated that thousands of complaints have been registered against him in various police stations across the country.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'the report stated' se pata chal raha ki main clause past mein hai, toh 'that' ke baad poora sub clause bhi past mein hoga. isliye option B aur D galat honge. Sentence mein matlab dena hai 'thousands complaint register kari gayi hai', toh iss meaning ke liye isse passive voice mein likhenge, isliye option A 'had been registered against him' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In the ancient world, new trade routes were being appeared as merchants travelled across deserts and seas in search of rare goods.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Option C nahi hoga kyunki 'ancient world' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, lekin 'have appeared' present perfect tense hai. Option B bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'appear' static verb hai jiski 'ing' form galat hai. 'were being appeared' bhi galat hoga kyunki isse sentence ka matlab 'new trade route ko appear kiya jaa raha tha', 'appear' static verb hai jiska passive galat hoga. Sentence ka meaning chahiye 'ancient world mein, new trade route bante the jab merchant travel karte the desert aur sea se', isliye yahan 'appeared' sahi hoga jo ki happening verb ki tarah se kaam karegi.

questions.question: She is working as a research analyst in Bengaluru for the past five years, and during this period she has contributed to several international projects.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'for the past five year' se pata chal raha ki koi action past se lekar present tak ho raha hai, aur 'for + duration' ke sath present perfect continuous tense ka use hota hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se 'has been working' perfect continuous sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: How many cars had they bought till date as part of their expanding rental business in the city?
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'till date' se pata chal raha ki past se lekar ab tak unhone kitne gaadi khareedi', past se lekar ab tak ke liye present perfect/continuous tense ka use hota hai, toh diye gaye options mein se 'have they bought' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Most students avoid studying with him since he is distracting others by cracking jokes and making unnecessary comments in class every day.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'every day' se pata chal raha ki wo aisa roz karta hai, toh sentence mein ek habitual action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye isse present indefinite tense mein likhenge, toh diye gaye options mein se option A 'he distracts others' present indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: These days, my cousins are been planning to renovate their old farmhouse located in a remote village in Nainital district.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'these days' likha hai jiske sath present indefinite/continuous/ perfect tense teeno aa sakte hai, depend karta hai meaning kya chahiye. Iss sentence ka matlab chahiye 'inn dino mere cousins plan kar rahe farmhouse ko renovate karne ka', toh sentence ke meaning ke according continuous tense sabse sahi hoga, isliye diye gaye options mein se option B 'are planning' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: One of the important chapters in this book had not yet been explained by our professor.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'one of' ke baad noun plural aata hai aur verb 'one' ke according singular aati hai. aur 'yet' se pata chal raha ki pehle se lekar abhi tak wala meaning chahiye, jiske liye perfect tense ka use karte hai, toh 'one' ke according singular verb aur perfect tense wala option sahi hoga, isliye option C 'has not been explained yet' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The wedding arrangements has been completed before most of the guests started arriving at the venue.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'arrived' se pata chal raha ki 'guests' past mein aaye honge matlab 'weddings arrangements' wala kaam guest ke aane se pehle hoga aur 'before' se bhi pata chal raha ki arrangements pehle hongi, isliye isse past perfect tense mein likhenge, toh diye gaye options mein se option C 'had been completed' past perfect sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When we reached the riverside at sunset, a group of travelers has been setting up their tents and arranging firewood for the night stay.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'when' ke sath 'reached' past mein likha hai, matlab dono action sath mein chalenge, toh tent set up karne action bhi past mein hoga, kyunki travelers tent set up aur firewood arrange kar rahe the, matlab tense past continuous mein hoga, isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'were setting' past continuous sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The bus driver talk to a passenger when the bus suddenly hit a speed breaker, causing everyone to jerk forward.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein bus driver ka passengers se baat karne wala action koi habitual action nahi hai, isliye yahan present indefinite galat hoga, sentence ka matlab hai 'jab driver passengers se baat kar raha tha tab achanak se bus speed breaker se hit ho gayi', toh yeh clearly past ki baat ho rahi hai, aur driver baat kar raha tha matlab continuous tense aayega, isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'was talking' past continuous sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I have been travelling to different countries before, so I am comfortable dealing with airport procedures and immigration checks.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai 'mein pehle different countries travel kar chuka, isliye mein comfortable hoo'. Toh sentence mein past ke action ka effect present mein chahiye, isliye yahan present perfect tense ka use hoga, isliye option A 'have travelled' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The headquarters of this international organization are establishing in Geneva, where many global meetings are held.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'headquarters' noun ke sath singular/plural aa sakti hai, depend karte hai uss headquarters ki building kitni hai. 'are establishing' se sentence ka matlab hoga ki 'headquarters' establish ho rahe hai, lekin aage likha hai ki meeting hoti hai, isliye 'are establishing' galat hoga. matlab chahiye ki headquarters Geneva mein hai, ek fact ki tarah batana hai, isliye yahan present indefinite tense 'is established' option D sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After finishing the first round of inspection at the construction site, the engineer is noticing several cracks forming near the basement walls.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein bataya ki 'first round finish karne ke baad engineer ne notice kiye several cracks', toh 'inspection' wala kaam past mein hua hai, tabhi usne 'notice' kiya honge cracks, isliye yahan past indefinite tense ka use hoga, isliye option B 'noticed' past indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The university authorities have promised to improve and enhance digital learning facilities before the next academic session begins.
options: have promised to improve and enhanced
has promised to improve and enhance
have promise to improve and enhance
questions.solution: No improvement required

questions.question: These days, teenagers are becoming conscious in the importance of managing their screen time wisely, as excessive use of gadgets can seriously affect their mental health and productivity.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'these days' likha hai jiske sath present indefinite/continuous/ perfect tense teeno aa sakte hai, depend karta hai meaning kya chahiye, toh 'are becoming concious' aur 'have become conscious' dono theek hai, lekin isme preposition galat likhi hai, 'conscious' ke sath 'of' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye option B 'are becoming conscious of' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Over the past year, regular awareness campaigns by doctors improve public understanding of the importance of timely vaccinations for children and adults.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence mein 'over the past year' se matlab hai pichle kuch saalon se regular campaign ne improve kari hai, matlab past ke action ka effect present mein dikhaana hai, isliye yahan present perfect tense sahi hoga, toh option A 'have improved public understanding' perfect tense sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Last year, our football team performed exceptionally well in the state championship, but doesn't secure a place in the national finals despite strong efforts.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai 'pichle saal humhari team ne bahut accha perform kiya, lekin national final mein apni jagah pakki nahi kar paaye', toh secure naa karne action bhi past mein hoga, isliye diye gaye options mein se 'but didn't secure a place' past indefinite tense sabse sahi answer hoga.
